authored_derived_unit_checks.statement: For a 16x16 complete Hadamard set, 256 signed coefficients require 512 complementary physical display events
authored_derived_unit_checks.basis: N=256 and two displays per coefficient; excludes extra controls, repetitions and overhead

authored_derived_unit_checks.statement: At 200 microseconds per physical display, 512 displays take 0.1024 seconds before additional overhead
authored_derived_unit_checks.basis: Static arithmetic check, not a simulated or measured performance

authored_derived_unit_checks.statement: 14.6 MHz times 100 photons per pulse times 5 ms equals 7.3 million incident photons per displayed pattern; the 0.5-photon, 1-second endpoint yields the same figure
authored_derived_unit_checks.basis: Derived budget at the stated calibrated incident reference plane, before subsequent object transmission, conversion and detection losses; the defining attenuation is already reflected in mean photons per pulse. Not detected photons or total image dose.

grading_rule: Reported images and values motivate comparisons, never fabricate hidden expected outputs or pass thresholds. No source outcome is claimed to have been reproduced.
